summary.zh-Hant: 英暹條約互換批准書：暹羅把對吉蘭丹、登嘉樓、吉打、玻璃市的宗主、保護、行政與管轄權移交英國
summary.en: Ratifications of the Anglo-Siamese Treaty exchanged: Siam transfers its rights over Kelantan, Trengganu, Kedah and Perlis to Great Britain

citations.locator: Doc. 498（美國駐暹公使 1909-05-13 函所附條約全文），Article 1
citations.evidenceNote: 條約第 1 條：「The Siamese Government transfers to the British Government all rights of suzerainty, protection, administration,」（對 Kelantan、Tringganu、Kedah、Perlis 及鄰近島嶼）；「Done at Bangkok in duplicate the tenth day of March in the year one thousand nine hundred and nine.」
citations.gradeBasis: 條約本文（當事方自己的文書）。證明移交的內容與簽字日，不證明生效日。

citations.evidenceNote: 「Signed at Bangkok, March 10, 1909.」「[Ratifications exchanged at London, July 9, 1909.]」
citations.gradeBasis: 官方條約文本的第三方轉錄本（原件 A，轉錄本記 B）。證明批准書互換日。

timeNote.zh-Hant: 條約 1909-03-10 在曼谷簽字，1909-07-09 在倫敦互換批准書後生效；本事件記的是生效日。暹羅在資料庫裡還沒有對應的政權，所以沒有列為參與方。
timeNote.en: Signed at Bangkok on 10 March 1909; in force on the exchange of ratifications at London on 9 July 1909, which is the date recorded here. Siam has no regime record yet and is not listed as a participant.
